findings.description: active() returns True when now equals expires_at, but the specification requires tokens to be inactive at or after expires_at.
findings.evidence: candidate.active(10, 10) returns True, but per spec it should return False because the token is not active strictly before its expiry.

review.summary: Candidate incorrectly implements active() logic for boundary case where now equals expires_at, violating the contract that requires tokens to be active strictly before expires_at.
